entities.summary: Winston Guy Jr. is an American former professional football player who was a safety in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Kentucky Wildcats. Guy was selected by the Seattle Seahawks in the sixth round of the 2012 NFL draft. He also played for the Jacksonville Jaguars and Indianapolis Colts.
